title: CB3D16 large-rotation beam-column (CR kernel) vs ANSYS 18.0 BEAM188+NLGEOM
description: FEM-Eigen fem_3d_nl.hpp co-rotational beam (bisecting-vector triad, analytic geometric stiffness crBeamTangent12, Newton with load steps) is exported by beam_nl_probe.exe. ANSYS 18.0 uses 2-node BEAM188 with ASEC section, NLGEOM,ON, NSUBST/NEQIT and writes nodal UX/UY/UZ/ROTX/ROTY/ROTZ CSV. CIRCLE: cantilever end moment M=lambda*2*pi*E*Iz/L, n=8, lambda=1 rolls the beam into a full circle. PDELTA: simply supported beam-column with P=lambda*Pcr and midspan Q=2e4 N, n=64, amplification 1 to ~3.96. PDELTA group uses KEYOPT(3)=2 cubic interpolation and G raised 1000x to remove Timoshenko shear locking and shear flexibility so that BEAM188 matches the EB kernel.

derived_rules.scale: max |ANSYS value| of that DOF over all nodes in the case
